summary: Address code smell: Shotgun Surgery: expected_version locals in koru autopilot install checks

delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm Shotgun Surgery smell for the variable 'expected_version' in src/koru/autopilot/install_checks.py (planfile ticket PLF-056, reported at line 243) by replacing the generic local with a stage-accurate name in each of the six functions that assigned it: source_vsix_version (check_plugin_installed_version_mismatch_issue and check_plugin_version_mismatch_issue, the version the source VSIX/package declares, contrasted with the installed extension and the connected plugin - both issue messages already say 'the source VSIX/package'), expected_installed_version (check_plugin_installed_ok_but_not_connected_issue and check_plugin_socket_candidate_mismatch_issue, the version the on-disk install must match before the secondary condition applies), live_host_expected_version (check_plugin_live_host_stale_issue, the version the live extension host is judged against for the install-match gate and the stale-reconnect classification) and expected_connected_version (_plugin_live_connection_matches_expected, the normalized str-coerced/stripped version the live connection must report, pairing with connected_version as expected_build pairs with connected_build). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'expected_version' group drops from 6 scopes to 0 and the file mutation record count is unchanged at 46 (pure rename). The new names land at 2/2/1/1 scopes, all far below the threshold; the untouched 'installed_version' and '_' groups stay at 4. Private-helper parameters named expected_version (_plugin_install_matches_expected, _stale_rejected_plugins, _is_stale_rejected_plugin) are function arguments, not assignments, so the DFG mutation extractor never counted them and they keep the accurate generic name. Pure rename: no signature, return shape, dict key or behavior change; no other file touched. No duplication.toon.yaml exists in this repository, so the duplication-report checklist has nothing to consult for the touched path.
nonGoals: No behavior, issue codes, message text semantics or interface change

No new shared version-comparison helper; the six reads differ (installed vs source VSIX, install-match gate, live-host staleness reference, normalized connection comparison) and a forced abstraction would couple independent check stages
No rename of the private-helper parameters or of locals in other files that happen to use 'expected_version' (each is an independent local in its own file scope)

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local naming only, inside one module. Every check function that read plugin['expected_version'] now names exactly the piece of the version comparison its stage consumes: the two mismatch reporters name the source VSIX/package version (source_vsix_version), the two install-match gates name the version the install must match (expected_installed_version), the live-host staleness check names the version the live host is judged against (live_host_expected_version) and the normalized connection comparison names its required connected version (expected_connected_version). The generic name 'expected_version' disappears from the file's assignment set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports an 'expected_version' mutation group of exactly 6 scopes - check_plugin_installed_version_mismatch_issue, check_plugin_installed_ok_but_not_connected_issue, check_plugin_live_host_stale_issue, _plugin_live_connection_matches_expected, check_plugin_socket_candidate_mismatch_issue, check_plugin_version_mismatch_issue - matching the ticket's 'spans 6 functions'; after the rename the 'expected_version' group is empty, the file mutation record count is unchanged at 46 (pure rename), and no (file, variable) group reaches the >= 5 threshold.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named expected_version again and the smell report returns.

validation.evidence: Deterministic ground truth with the installed code2llm extractor on the file AST. Baseline content reports an 'expected_version' mutation group of 6 scopes (check_plugin_installed_version_mismatch_issue, check_plugin_installed_ok_but_not_connected_issue, check_plugin_live_host_stale_issue, _plugin_live_connection_matches_expected, check_plugin_socket_candidate_mismatch_issue, check_plugin_version_mismatch_issue) - exactly matching the ticket's reported 'spans 6 functions'; renamed content reports an 'expected_version' group of 0 scopes; file mutation record count unchanged at 46 (pure rename); every new local lands below the threshold (source_vsix_version 2, expected_installed_version 2, live_host_expected_version 1, expected_connected_version 1); the untouched 'installed_version' and '_' groups stay at 4 scopes.

The suites that exercise the renamed issue-check paths (unit tests for install_checks plus the manage-command suite that drives the install manager issue chain) pass unchanged - pure rename of function-internal locals - and ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree with the changed files declared.
